messages:
Maya Patel: Quick preflight question — planning to enable orchard-13b in the catalog during tonight's 20:00 UTC change window. Main things to confirm: skiplist for sensitive tenants, fallback ordering, and pin for enterprise customers. Anyone see immediate red flags?
Devon Lee: skim looks ok. skiplist: finance-prod + med-data-prod + gov-eu. We'll exclude them from the 1st wave.
Samir Chen: telemetry gating: define explicit rollback signals — latency p95 > 1200ms for 10m OR error-rate > 0.5% for 5m. Agree?
Maya Patel: yes to both. Also add quality regression if prompt-set eval drops > 3% against baseline.
Devon Lee: fallback ordering proposal: orchard-quant -> orchard-8bit -> default-13b. Keep quant first for cost.
Priya Rao: Docs & release notes: I'll add an entry under "Model catalog" noting canary %, skiplist, and fallback order. Will also add customer-facing note for enterprise pinning.
Lina Gomez: ops checklist: create drain window for canary nodes, set eviction grace to 90s, and watch per-region slot saturation. I'll own dashboards.
Samir Chen: small nit — for enterprise pinned tenants we should serve a pinned variant id, not rely on fallback. I'll add a rule: route tenant tag "enterprise" -> variant orchard-13b@v1.3.
Maya Patel: good call. add a config snippet in the deploy runbook?
Devon Lee: here's the deploy command we'll run (deploy-bot will execute):
```
/deploy catalog enable --model orchard-13b --canary 5% --skiplist finance-prod,med-data-prod,gov-eu --fallback-order orchard-quant,orchard-8bit,default-13b --pin-tag enterprise:orchard-13b@v1.3
```
Maya Patel: deploy-bot — can you schedule the run for 20:00 UTC and post a confirmation + rollback hook?
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: job_id=job-98765, run_at=1749307200 (20:00 UTC). Rollback hook attached: `/deploy catalog rollback job-98765 --reason=<signal>` 
Devon Lee: Confirming monitoring: Samir you'll watch latency + errors, Lina watches resource usage, Priya watches customer notes. Team on-call ping list is in the runbook.
Samir Chen: I'll also enable a short-latency probe that hits 50 sample prompts across regions every 2m for first 30m. If median latency regresses by >10% I'll hit rollback.
Lina Gomez: Dashboards linked in runbook. I'll post a pinned alert channel with thresholds and escalation matrix.
Priya Rao: Release notes PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/112 — added canary and skiplist details. Please review.
Maya Patel: final ask — can we keep the canary window to 60 minutes then evaluate? If all good, ramp to 50% over next 2 hours. If not, immediate rollback.
Devon Lee: +1. We'll use a staged ramp: 5% -> 20% (30m) -> 50% (next 90m) with manual checks at each step.
Samir Chen: I'll create a short playbook for rollback reasons (latency/error/quality) and paste into this thread before deploy.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. Once deploy-bot confirms the scheduled run I'll mark this preflight done. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: job-98765 will execute at 1749307200. Reminder: to abort before run use `/deploy cancel job-98765`.
